# Concentric Corners

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Layout

Native sheets adapt their corners automatically. For custom bottom panels on iOS 26+, use ConcentricRectangle to resolve corners relative to the container, without reading a device radius. UICornerRadius is the UIKit counterpart. Keep native presentationCornerRadius unset or nil to retain system defaults.

- Before: Fixed radius ignores the container
- After: Bottom corners follow the container

APIs: `ConcentricRectangle`, `containerShape`, `UICornerRadius`, `presentationCornerRadius`, `concentric(minimum:)`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SheetCornersDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    var body: some View {
        VStack {
            SheetCornersDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(width: 260, height: 180)
            Button("Change container corners") { phase += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct SheetCornersDoContent: View {
    let phase: Int

    var body: some View {
        if #available(iOS 26, macOS 26, *) {
            // An illustrative container, not a measured device radius.
            let container = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 24 : 48)
            VStack {
                Text("Container preview").font(.caption)
                Spacer(minLength: 8)
                panel
                    .frame(height: 65)
                    .padding(8)
            }
            .padding(.top, 12)
            .containerShape(container)
            .background(.quaternary, in: container)
        } else {
            Text("Requires iOS 26 or later")
        }
    }

    @available(iOS 26, macOS 26, *)
    private var panel: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        Text("Bottom panel")
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            .background(.tint.opacity(0.25), in:
                ConcentricRectangle(
                    uniformTopCorners: .fixed(16),
                    uniformBottomCorners: .concentric(minimum: .fixed(8))
                )
            )
        // A system container supplies its shape automatically.
        // For a custom container, set containerShape on the parent.
        // excerpt:end
    }
}
```
